properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.api-key
properties.description: The IBM Cloud API key, exchanged at IBM Cloud IAM for an access token that is sent to watsonx.ai. Required unless oauthProfile or authenticator is set, or the operation is processToolCalls, which runs locally; when several are set, authenticator is used first, then oauthProfile.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.authenticator
properties.description: A custom authenticator of the watsonx.ai SDK (com.ibm.watsonx.ai.core.auth.Authenticator) that gives the token of every request, such as a CP4DAuthenticator for watsonx.ai software on Cloud Pak for Data. When set, apiKey and oauthProfile are not used. The option is a com.ibm.watsonx.ai.core.auth.Authenticator type.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.auto-rotation-correction
properties.description: Whether text extraction and classification correct the rotation of the pages

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.autowired-enabled
properties.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.base-url
properties.description: The watsonx.ai API URL of the region, such as https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com or https://eu-de.ml.cloud.ibm.com. The endpoint does not start without it, unless its operation is runTool or listTools, which call the wxUrl instead, or processToolCalls, which runs locally.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.classification-mode
properties.description: How text classification classifies: exact (the document type) or binary (whether it is one)

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.configuration
properties.description: The configuration that the endpoints share. Each endpoint starts from a copy of it, and its URI options override the copied values. The option is a org.apache.camel.component.ibm.watsonx.ai.WatsonxAiConfiguration type.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.cos-url
properties.description: The endpoint URL of the IBM Cloud Object Storage region of the document and result buckets, such as https://s3.us-south.cloud-object-storage.appdomain.cloud. Required for text extraction and text classification.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.deployment-id
properties.description: The ID of the deployment of deploymentInfo, deploymentGenerate, deploymentChat and deploymentForecast. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiDeploymentId header overrides it; when neither is set, these operations fail.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.detect-hap
properties.description: Whether detect looks for hate, abuse and profanity (HAP), when neither the detectors option nor the CamelIBMWatsonxAiDetectors header is set. When neither detectPii nor detectHap is set, detect uses both detectors.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.detect-pii
properties.description: Whether detect looks for personal identifiable information (PII), when neither the detectors option nor the CamelIBMWatsonxAiDetectors header is set. When neither detectPii nor detectHap is set, detect uses both detectors.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.detection-threshold
properties.description: The threshold (0 to 1) of the detectors of detect, detectContext and detectGenerated, but the PII detector, which takes none. The defaults of watsonx.ai apply when not set.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.detectors
properties.description: The detectors, comma separated, in the place of detectPii and detectHap: hap, pii and granite_guardian for detect, context_relevance and faithfulness for detectContext (default context_relevance), answer_relevance for detectGenerated (default answer_relevance). The detectionThreshold applies to all but pii

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.document-bucket
properties.description: The Cloud Object Storage bucket of the documents of text extraction and text classification: the upload operations upload into it, and the operations with a file path read the document from it. Required for these operations.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.document-connection-id
properties.description: The ID of the connection asset, in the project or space, that gives watsonx.ai access to the documentBucket. Required for text extraction and text classification.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.document-languages
properties.description: The languages of the documents of text extraction and classification, comma separated ISO 639 codes, such as en,fr

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.embedded-images
properties.description: What text extraction does with the images of the document

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable auto configuration of the ibm-watsonx-ai component. This is enabled by default.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.extraction-mode
properties.description: The quality of text extraction: standard or high_quality

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.extraction-outputs
properties.description: The outputs of text extraction, comma separated: md (the default), json, html, plain_text, page_images. The operations that return the text (AndFetch) take one output, but page_images

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.frequency-penalty
properties.description: The penalty of chat for tokens in proportion to how often they already appear, from -2 to 2: positive values make the answer repeat itself less. There is no header for it.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.governance-instance-id
properties.description: The watsonx.governance instance that runs the detectors of detectContext and detectGenerated (and of detect, in the place of the project or space), which IBM Cloud requires for them

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.guided-choice
properties.description: Guided decoding of chat: the answer is one of these comma separated choices

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.guided-grammar
properties.description: Guided decoding of chat: the answer follows this context free grammar (EBNF)

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.guided-regex
properties.description: Guided decoding of chat: the answer matches this regular expression

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.include-reasoning
properties.description: Whether watsonx.ai returns the reasoning of the model, in the CamelIBMWatsonxAiReasoningContent header

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.json-schema
properties.description: A JSON schema (as JSON text) that the chat answer follows (the json_schema response format)

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.json-schema-strict
properties.description: Whether the chat answer must follow the jsonSchema strictly

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.kvp-mode
properties.description: The key-value pair extraction of text extraction: disabled, invoice, ubill or generic_with_semantic. When not set, text extraction extracts no key-value pairs.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.lazy-start-producer
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.log-requests
properties.description: Whether to log HTTP requests to the watsonx.ai API

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.log-responses
properties.description: Whether to log HTTP responses from the watsonx.ai API

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.max-completion-tokens
properties.description: The maximum number of tokens of the answer of chat, chatStreaming and deploymentChat. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiMaxNewTokens header overrides it.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.max-new-tokens
properties.description: The maximum number of tokens that textGeneration, textGenerationStreaming and deploymentGenerate generate. Chat uses maxCompletionTokens instead. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiMaxNewTokens header overrides it.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.model-id
properties.description: The ID of the foundation model, such as ibm/granite-4-h-small, of textGeneration, chat, embedding, rerank, tokenize, forecast and their streaming variants. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiModelId header overrides it for chat and chatStreaming. The deployment operations use the model of the deployment instead.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.moderation-granite-guardian
properties.description: Chat guardrail: whether watsonx.ai checks the input with Granite Guardian (watsonx.ai applies it to the input only)

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.moderation-hap
properties.description: Chat guardrail: whether watsonx.ai checks the input and the answer for hate, abuse and profanity (HAP)

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.moderation-pii
properties.description: Chat guardrail: whether watsonx.ai checks the input and the answer for personal identifiable information (PII)

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.moderation-threshold
properties.description: The threshold (0 to 1) of the HAP and Granite Guardian chat guardrails

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.number-of-choices
properties.description: How many answers chat generates for the request (n). The body is the first one, and the CamelIBMWatsonxAiAssistantMessages header has them all

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.oauth-profile
properties.description: OAuth profile name for obtaining an access token via the OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials grant. When set, the token of the configured identity provider is sent to watsonx.ai as a Bearer token instead of an IBM Cloud API key, and obtained again when it expires. Requires camel-oauth on the classpath.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.ocr-mode
properties.description: The optical character recognition of text extraction and classification: auto, disabled, enabled or forced

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.operation
properties.description: The operation to perform. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiOperation header overrides it; when neither is set, the exchange fails.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.output-dpi
properties.description: The resolution, in dots per inch, of the images that text extraction outputs.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.output-tokens
properties.description: Whether text extraction gives the tokens of the text, with their positions

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.prediction-length
properties.description: The number of time steps to forecast (forecast and deploymentForecast). The model forecasts its own default length when not set

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.presence-penalty
properties.description: The penalty of chat for any token that already appeared, from -2 to 2: positive values make the model move on to new topics. There is no header for it.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.processing-timeout
properties.description: How long the text extraction and classification operations that wait (AndFetch) wait for the result, in milliseconds. Defaults to the timeout of the endpoint. The option is a java.lang.Long type.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.project-id
properties.description: The ID of the watsonx.ai project in which the operations of foundation models (textGeneration, chat, embedding, rerank, tokenize, forecast and their streaming variants), detection, text extraction and text classification run. Set projectId or spaceId. deploymentInfo looks the deployment up in this project when no space ID is set.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.reasoning-effort
properties.description: How much the model of chat reasons: low, medium or high, for the models that support it

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.remove-output-file
properties.description: Whether the text extraction operations that wait (AndFetch) remove the output file from Cloud Object Storage once read (asynchronously)

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.remove-uploaded-file
properties.description: Whether the operations that upload and wait (UploadAndFetch) remove the uploaded document from Cloud Object Storage once the result is read (asynchronously)

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.repetition-penalty
properties.description: The penalty of text generation for repeating tokens it already generated: 1 means no penalty, and higher values repeat less. Chat does not use it (see frequencyPenalty). The CamelIBMWatsonxAiRepetitionPenalty header overrides it.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.rerank-top-n
properties.description: The number of best ranked inputs that rerank returns. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiRerankTopN header overrides it.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.response-format
properties.description: The format of the chat answer: text, or json for a JSON object. Set jsonSchema for an answer that follows a JSON schema

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.result-bucket
properties.description: The Cloud Object Storage bucket where text extraction writes its output files, which textExtractionReadFile and textExtractionDeleteFile read and delete unless the CamelIBMWatsonxAiBucketName header names another bucket. Required for text extraction.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.result-connection-id
properties.description: The ID of the connection asset, in the project or space, that gives watsonx.ai access to the resultBucket. Required for text extraction.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.return-documents
properties.description: Whether each result of rerank includes its input text, besides its index and score.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.seed
properties.description: The random seed of chat sampling, for repeatable answers

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.space-id
properties.description: The ID of the deployment space, in the place of projectId, in which the same operations run. deploymentInfo looks the deployment up in this space; there the CamelIBMWatsonxAiSpaceId header overrides it.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.stop
properties.description: Comma separated sequences that stop the generation of the chat answer

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.stream-endpoint
properties.description: The endpoint URI, such as seda:chunks, that receives each chunk of textGenerationStreaming and chatStreaming as a message when the CamelIBMWatsonxAiStreamConsumer header is not set. The chunks are sent from the threads of the watsonx.ai SDK, with the exchange ID of the streaming exchange in the CamelCorrelationId header.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.temperature
properties.description: The sampling temperature of text generation and chat (the streaming and deployment operations included), from 0 to 2: higher values give more random text. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiTemperature header overrides it.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.thinking
properties.description: Whether the model of chat reasons before it answers, for the models that support it (chat template thinking)

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.thinking-tags
properties.description: For models that write their reasoning in the answer between tags: the tag of the reasoning, and optionally the tag of the answer after a comma, such as think,response. The reasoning goes to the CamelIBMWatsonxAiReasoningContent header and the answer to the body

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.timeout
properties.description: The timeout of each HTTP request to watsonx.ai and to IBM Cloud IAM, in milliseconds; the watsonx.ai SDK uses 60 seconds when not set. The streaming operations wait for the end of the stream at most this timeout and 30 seconds more.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.tool-choice
properties.description: How the model chooses the tools of chat: auto (the model decides), required (the model must call a tool), none (the model must not call a tool), or the name of the tool the model must call

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.top-k
properties.description: The top-k sampling of text generation: the model picks the next token from this number of most likely tokens. Chat does not use it. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiTopK header overrides it.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.top-p
properties.description: The nucleus sampling of text generation and chat: the model picks the next token from the most likely tokens whose probabilities add up to this value (0 to 1). The CamelIBMWatsonxAiTopP header overrides it.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.truncate-input-tokens
properties.description: The maximum number of tokens of each input text of embedding: a longer input is truncated from the end, so that the request does not fail.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.verify-ssl
properties.description: Whether the watsonx.ai SDK verifies the TLS certificates of watsonx.ai, IBM Cloud IAM and Cloud Object Storage. Set it to false only for testing, as the connections then accept any certificate.

properties.name: camel.component.ibm-watsonx-ai.wx-url
properties.description: The watsonx.ai platform (WX) API URL of the region, such as https://api.dataplatform.cloud.ibm.com/wx or https://api.eu-de.dataplatform.cloud.ibm.com/wx, which runTool and listTools call. Required for these two operations.
